programme.title: Tropic Like It's Hot S1 - Episode 5
programme.desc: An Oklahoma couple searches for their dream beachfront property on Spanish Wells, Bahamas. But with high demand, they quickly learn that the Bahamian beach house they've always wanted might come with a higher price tag than they expected.

programme.title: Tropic Like It's Hot S1 - Episode 6
programme.desc: A couple who own two wedding venues in Texas are ready to find a Bahamian vacation home on the island of Eleuthera. After years of hosting everyone else's happily-ever-afters, they're finally taking a timeout to find a dream home for their own love story.

programme.title: Force Of Nature - Episode 6
programme.desc: The Force of Nature team were in the field for three years to make the series. In order to film how animals were coping with today's wilder weather, the team had to put up with some spectacular weather - mega monsoons; raging wildfires: unprecedented droughts; marine heatwaves; hurricanes and even tornadoes. With the help of some of the world's scientists, the crew were able to film some extraordinary examples of animals fighting back, adapting and digging deep to overcome what is fast becoming the new normal. In this episode, we turn the camera on the extraordinary people who are dedicating their lives to helping the animals cope with today's extreme weather. From the elephant scientist negotiating with palm oil plantations to allow Bornean elephant safe passage, to the team of Indian wildlife protection officers who rescue and relocate precious snow leopards. All around the world, people are making small changes which make a world of a difference. These are their stories.

programme.title: Neighborhood Watch S1 - Episode 17
programme.desc: Second chances. Do-overs. Mulligans. Everyone needs one now and again. When things go wrong, hindsight is 20/20, and it's easy to see what could have been done differently. Unfortunately for these neighbors, the cameras were recording the first time.

programme.title: Neighborhood Watch S1 - Episode 18
programme.desc: Welcome to life in the good old U-S-of-A. We've got crazy chickens and out-of-control golfcarts. Embarrassing dads and rollerblade wipeouts. Yard sale mishaps, practical jokes, wild kids, and runaway cows. It's just another day in the neighborhood.

programme.title: Vinnie Jones In The Country S2 - Episode 2
programme.desc: Vinnie plans an ambitious build ahead of his grandkid's visit which pushes Wobbly to his limits. On a mission to encourage Kingfishers to nest, he decides to make a stand against dog walkers and seeks solace in a fishing trip with Paul Whitehouse.

programme.title: Street Outlaws: End Game - EP9B
programme.desc: More locals keep coming looking for more races against the all-star team of Outlaws.

programme.title: Ant Anstead: Born Mechanic - Episode 7
programme.desc: Ant's sidekick and engineering expert Darren goes rogue when he heads to a car show and buys a 1964 Ford Thunderbird for them to restore. Although the T-Bird runs mechanically, it needs a facelift to return it to its 1960s glory including a new vinyl roof. But Ant's not a fan of this gigantic Jetbird. He's worried about how much the American parts will cost to source, but Darren's got a penny- pinching plan. Meanwhile, Ant's dad Nigel and brother Micheal need to source bricks for the farmhouse and strike a deal with Ant's Wheeler Dealer mate, Mike Brewer.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights S3 - Episode 5
programme.desc: The shooting of an East Texas football coach inside the high school fieldhouse triggers a lockdown in the middle of a school day. As police race to identify and track down an active shooter, they discover a community deeply divided by the coach's past.

programme.title: In The Eye Of The Storm S2 - Episode 11
programme.desc: When wind-driven fires explode across Los Angeles in January 2025, cameras capture chaos and heroism as residents attempt to rescue loved ones and flee burning neighborhoods, while the entire city faces one of the most destructive infernos in its history.

programme.title: Body Cam S3 - Episode 19
programme.desc: A stolen truck plows through farmers' fields ending in shots fired. A suspect swims for his freedom hiding on a dense mangrove island to evade police. And following a high-speed pursuit, officers dive for cover as a car race through their crime scene.

programme.title: Rawae' Al Alam Wasa'il Al Naql S10 - Episode 1
programme.desc: Planes, Trains and Automobiles explores humanity's drive to innovate, from the first wheel to today's transportation marvels. It highlights iconic railways like the Tasmanian Wilderness Railway, city-shaping subways and trams and road legends like Route 66. The evolution of carsreveals the spirit of progress, while airports and iconic planes celebrate our boundless quest for connection.

programme.title: Al Bassma Al Bashariyya - Episode 5
programme.desc: Earth has never experienced anything like us: a single species dominating and transforming the planet. Biologist Shane Campbell-Staton travels the globe to explore our impact. Because while we may tell ourselves what it means to be human, the clearest vision of who we are emerges from what we do. In that way, Human Footprint tackles the biggest story of all – the story of who we really are.

programme.title: Qitar Al Sharq Al Saree' - Episode 1
programme.desc: In the first episode of The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel, the legendary journey begins in London as the famous train sets off eastward toward Paris. Along the route, the documentary explores the early history of the Orient Express and its influence on European society, stopping at locations linked to figures whose fortunes and lives were transformed by the railway. The episode concludes in Paris with a visit to the iconic Moulin Rouge, uncovering the glamour, culture, and excitement that made the French capital one of the most celebrated stops on the legendary route.

programme.title: Alam al Tarmeem Al Khabeer al Majhool - Episode 1
programme.desc: The first in the series! This time, the items entrusted to us include a celadon vase that would be a national treasure if it were undamaged, and a broken soba choko (small soba cup) that was a favorite of screenwriter Kuniko Mukoda. In a workshop where mosaics are essential, the godly hands are in action, trying to pass on the treasures of humanity to future generations!

Qitar Al Sharq Al Saree' - Episode 2
programme.desc: In episode two of The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel, the journey continues east from Paris through the heart of continental Europe. Traveling across France and Germany, the documentary explores the rich history and cultural heritage of cities shaped by trade, industry, and the arrival of the railway age. Stops include the jewelry-making center of Pforzheim and Munich, where the past and present of Germany intertwine, before the route reaches the picturesque Austrian city of Salzburg. Along the way, the episode reveals how the Orient Express helped connect Europe's great cities, spreading ideas, culture, and prosperity across the continent.

programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey through history's most groundbreaking transportation marvels. From the wheel that sparked human progress to the Silk Road's vibrant exchanges, Roman roads that built empires and rockets that launched us into space - each innovation shattered limits and reshaped civilisation. Discover how these game-changers transformed our past and propel us into the future.

programme.title: Al Inhiar: AlMaal wa AlAnanya wa Al Khedaa Fi FTX - Episode 1
Alam al Tarmeem Al Khabeer al Majhool - Episode 3
programme.desc: The third in the series! Even a broken plate can be restored to its original shape. There is a restorer who can make any damage look as if it never existed. A technique that has not been seen for a long time. Permission was granted to film the restoration of a Qing Dynasty vase and a Joseon Dynasty white porcelain, both worth billions.

programme.title: Qitar Al Sharq Al Saree' - Episode 3
programme.desc: In episode three of The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel, the journey continues through the breathtaking landscapes of Austria, from the historic Semmering region to the grand imperial city of Vienna. Along the way, the documentary explores the engineering achievements and cultural legacy of Europe's railway age, while uncovering stories that shaped the continent's history. In Vienna, the route leads to the former home of Sigmund Freud, where viewers discover the connection between the father of psychoanalysis and the Orient Express during a pivotal chapter of his life. The journey then continues to Budapest, a city renowned for its thermal baths and rich heritage, where a unique railway operated by children offers a glimpse into one of Europe's most unusual transport traditions. Together, these stops reveal the diverse cultures, histories, and innovations that flourished along the legendary Orient Express route.

programme.title: Denzel Washington Araab Al Cinema Al Soda'a
programme.desc: In 30 years of a deeply committed career and 50 roles, Denzel Washington, double-Oscar winner, placed the figure of the Black man in all its complexity at the heart of the American paradoxes: from Black activist, rebel soldier to gangster torn between violence and charity. Voted best actor of the 21st century by the New York Times a few months ago, Denzel Washington, 65, has risen to the top of American cinema. As an Actor, director and producer, he has shaken up a "color line" as immutable as it is subtle. Often identified with his characters, he reveals himself to be disconcerting and paradoxical. As if he were holding up a mirror to America in which all of its contradictions and failings were reflected. A documentary that chronicles the extraordinary career of the world-renowned African-American actor.

programme.title: Al Inhiar: AlMaal wa AlAnanya wa Al Khedaa Fi FTX - Episode 2
Asia Thaqafat Al Shay - Episode 1
programme.desc: China, Japan, and Korea are all three major tea-consuming countries, and each has its own legend concerning how tea originated. Tea-drinking is a constituent part of Chinese culture. China is an original producer of tea and is renowned for its skills in planting and making tea. Among the parts of China that are famous for tea is the Yunnan province. The spread of Chinese tea and tea culture to eastern countries, especially lo Japan and Korea, is noticeable. In Japan, tea is not just a daily drink; preparing or serving tea is an art and a spiritual discipline. The love for tea among Japanese led to an artistic ceremony called Chanoyu. Typically, the origin of tea in Korea is attributed to monks who came from China. Buddhism played an integral part in Korean tea drinking, with Buddhist monks teaching the virtues of tea for developing mental discipline.

programme.title: Qitar Al Sharq Al Saree' - Episode 4
programme.desc: In the fourth and final episode of The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel, the legendary journey reaches its last and most evocative stage as the train travels through the Balkans toward Istanbul. Crossing the Dragoman Pass into Bulgaria, the documentary explores the region's complex history and the crucial role the Orient Express played in linking Eastern and Western Europe. In Sofia, viewers discover a palace filled with unexpected treasures and learn about key chapters of Bulgaria's turbulent past. The journey then continues through landscapes shaped by centuries of cultural exchange before arriving in Istanbul, the iconic destination that inspired the train's enduring mystique. As the Orient Express reaches its historic terminus, the episode reflects on the legacy of a railway service that transformed travel and connected continents, cultures, and generations.

programme.title: Soulalat Kim - Episode 1
programme.desc: In the geopolitics of our time, North Korea takes center stage. It is at the top of the international agenda of the great powers because of its strategy of constant threats carried out by three successive generations of the ruling family. With the help of leading experts, including former Pyongyang regime officials, this film seeks to uncover North Korea's ultimate plan, its goal, and the length it is ready to go to achieve it.

programme.title: Государственная грамота. Семейный кодекс
programme.desc: Как в разные времена регулировались семейные отношения? Документальный цикл рассказывает о правовых нормах, определявших судьбы людей – от «Русской правды» до советского семейного кодекса. Почему первым в семейном праве возник закон о наследстве? Как «Домострой» на самом деле относился к женщине? Почему большевики запретили усыновление и зачем ввели обязательное заявление о зачатии? Россия

programme.title: Вечерняя Астрахань
programme.desc: Мы ежедневно приносим вам свежие репортажи с мест событий, чтобы вы были в курсе всего, что происходит рядом с вами. programme.title: Всем подъем!
programme.desc: Энергичный старт дня гарантирован: свежие идеи для хобби, лайфхаки для дома, обзоры интересных событий и советы по организации досуга. Здесь каждый найдет что-то полезное для себя – будь то вдохновение для творчества, рекомендации по активному отдыху или подборка необычных увлечений. Россия

programme.desc: Вера решает навестить Настю и приезжает в станицу Вольная, чтобы собственными глазами увидеть, в каких условиях растет ребенок. Оказавшись на месте, она с облегчением замечает, что маленький Вовка окружен искренней заботой, семейным теплом и материнской любовью. Это наблюдение окончательно успокаивает Веру: все сомнения рассеиваются, и она убеждается, что совершила правильный поступок. Реж: Виталий Москаленко. programme.title: Atlantis: El día de los Muertos
programme.desc: La pandilla se encuentra dispersa alrededor de una antigua necrópolis. Y pronto se dan cuenta de que no están solos: el espacio está repleto de un ejército mágico de muertos vivientes.

programme.title: Atlantis: Las hermanas grises
programme.desc: Mientras Ariadna yace en su lecho de muerte, la culpa de Jasón es casi insoportable. Decide hacer todo lo posible para salvarla y se embarca en una peligrosa búsqueda hacia lo desconocido.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.sub-title: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando la noticia llega a Pasífae sobre el inminente matrimonio de Ariadna y Jasón, está aterrorizada de que Atlantis se pierda para siempre y decide hacer todo lo posible para detener la unión.

programme.title: Atlantis: La locura de Hércules
programme.desc: A medida que Pasífae aumenta su control sobre la Atlántida, el futuro parece sombrío. Hércules sabe que solo hay una forma de salvar a sus amigos: Medusa. ¿Es un riesgo que está dispuesto a correr?

programme.title: Atlantis: La mirada de la Gorgona
programme.desc: Pasífae se ha apoderado de Atlantis y solo una cosa es segura: se necesitará un sacrificio de proporciones inimaginables para arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Atlantis: La muerte de la luz
programme.desc: La profecía del Oráculo se ha hecho realidad: las revelaciones sobre Pasífae han ennegrecido el corazón de Jasón. Desesperado por salvar a su amigo, Pitágoras parte en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Atlantis: Familiares
programme.desc: Cuando nuestros héroes descubren que Jasón ha sido atrapado por las tropas de Pasífae, saben que deben hacer todo lo posible para rescatarlo antes de que se pierda para siempre.

programme.title: Atlantis: La reina debe morir - Parte 1
programme.desc: Jasón está decidido a rescatar a sus compañeros de prisión del anfiteatro. Pero esto significa volver a la Atlántida, el corazón del poder de Pasífae.

programme.title: Atlantis: La reina debe morir - Parte 2
programme.desc: Jasón está decidido a rescatar a sus compañeros de prisión del anfiteatro.

programme.title: S28E5 - Nema priča
programme.desc: Že 23 sezon spremljamo predano ekipo forenzičnih patologov, ki poskušajo ugotoviti, kako in zakaj je žrtev umrla, pri čemer tvegajo svoja življenja. Vsa trupla razkrivajo zgodbo. Njihova zgodba je skrivnost, ki jo je treba razvozlati, truplo pa je njen ključ. Dr. Nikki Alexander, dr. Thomas Chamberlain in dr. Jack Hodgson delajo v uglednem Centru Lyell, kjer pri različnih preiskavah podajajo svoja strokovna mnenja glede okoliščin zločina. Truplo, najdeno v betonskem stebru na parkirišču, strmoglavljeno letalo, znanstvena raziskava je šla po zlu ... Primeri, ki končajo v centru Lyell, so le redko enostavni. Ko se dokazi začnejo kopičiti, se prvotni sumi razblinijo in Nikki ter ekipa se morajo skoraj nadčloveško potruditi, da pridejo do resnice.

programme.title: Shared Future for Asia Pacific: Best-selling hair dryer highlights strengths of southern China's cross-border supply chain
programme.desc: As China hosts APEC 2026, regional integration is taking center stage. In southern China's Greater Bay Area, cities like Zhuhai, Hengqin, and Macao are operating like a single supply chain network, linking automated factories with global talent and capital. To see how this cross-border teamwork helps brands go global, CGTN's Yu Hongyu takes us inside a hair dryer factory in Zhuhai.

programme.title: Behind every screen: Shenzhen lights up the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: From the phone in your pocket to the giant screens lighting up city skylines, a huge share of the world's displays trace back to one place: China's Greater Bay Area, specifically Shenzhen. Panels and LED modules... the whole chain sits within a few hours' drive, and that's what lets companies scale fast. Our reporter Wang Tianyu went inside the industry to find out how Shenzhen is putting that edge to work for customers worldwide.

programme.title: From bikes to your phone: Carbon fiber weaves the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Carbon fiber-once reserved for aerospace and elite racing-is now powering a much broader industrial shift across the Asia-Pacific. In southern China, Guangdong province is turning lower-cost mass production into a major export advantage. CGTN's Yu Hongyu explores how this featherlight thread is is driving billions in APEC trade.

programme.title: OFFSHORE WIND Powers the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: You flip a switch, and the lights come on. But where does that power come from? In Yangjiang, Guangdong, the answer lies offshore. The city leads all of China's prefecture-level cities in offshore wind capacity, backed by a growing industrial chain spanning turbine manufacturing, testing and operations. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun takes you inside China's offshore wind industry and explores how it is helping power the Asia-Pacific's green transition.

programme.title: From receptionist to manager: Elizabeth's 8-year journey at a Chinese firm
programme.desc: Elizabeth Lindon, a 46-year-old from Papua New Guinea, is now a senior supervisor at BNBM PNG in Port Moresby. Over eight years, she has worked her way up from office receptionist to forklift operator--breaking the stereotype that operating forklifts is "a man's job"--and then moving into management. Her journey shows how China-APEC cooperation translates into real benefits for individuals and families. CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: How a Chinese company helped Danang's tofu business thrive in Indonesia
programme.desc: Pak Danang makes tofu in Mendis Village, Indonesia. He once had no license and no steady buyers -- until China Datang Power Plant stepped in with hygiene training, permits, soybeans and a supply deal with a company cafeteria. His monthly income has since jumped from IDR 12 million to 42 million ($2,300). A livelihood transformed, one block of tofu at a time. This is China-APEC cooperation made real! CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: From 36 hours to 40 minutes: Peruvian captain's
programme.desc: Freyder Caldas Cierto ferries villagers along Peru's Huallaga River for EGH, operator of the Chaglla Hydropower Plant. Since 2015, the free community boat service has served five villages -- turning a day-and-a-half-long mule ride into a 40-minute trip. A Chinese-operated project connecting riverside lives, one trip at a time! CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: Travel the world without a passport - inside CIIE's Country Exhibition
programme.desc: This year's Country Exhibition is the expo's "international living room," welcoming Canada back as Guest Country of Honor and Sri Lanka for its debut. It also features first-time participants Moldova, Romania, and UNDP, bringing together advanced and emerging economies. It's a showcase of unique products, cultures, and business opportunities. What new surprises await? Follow CGTN's Wu Bin and Chen Tong for a global tour under one roof.

programme.title: Live: What's next after CIIE 2026?
programme.desc: What stood out at this year's China International Import Expo (CIIE)? And what does it mean for businesses? In our closing livestream, CGTN reporters share what they've seen – from new trends in tech to changing preferences among Chinese consumers. They'll also discuss what these changes mean for global companies and the opportunities China's market offers.

programme.title: Meet China: Turning Villages into Stages, Taking Creativity to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we step into the frontlines of rural revitalization to see how a Gen-Z village chief is breathing new life into her hometown. We then visit the world’s toy capital, where Chinese manufacturing is turning culture and creativity into global stories. From a green beef cycle near Beijing to rice-prawn co-culture in Cambodia, this episode explores how technology, industry and cooperation are helping land thrive and livelihoods grow.

programme.title: Meet China: A Cup of Tea, A City of Legends, A Journey of Culture
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China,we travel to Kaifeng, Henan, to explore Wansuishan Martial Arts City—a theme park with no roller coasters that still drew over 24 million visits in 2025. We discover how its“three-day unlimited entry”ticket and immersive NPC interactions turn traditional martial arts culture into a modern sensation. Then, we trace the supply chain of a Chinese tea brand from lemon orchards in central China to global markets, uncovering how vertical integration makes high-quality fruit tea possible for under two dollars a cup. From a city, a cup of tea, and a piece of clothing, this episode shows how a new generation is sharing Chinese culture with confidence and creativity.

programme.title: Awakening Ancient Myths, Pursuing Dreams on Screen
programme.desc: How can technology bring ancient legends to life? How does Hengdian, the "World’s Largest Studio," fuel a global short-drama craze? In this episode of Meet China, we explore the cutting edge of cultural production. In Mianyang, Sichuan, we witness how digital innovation turns Eastern myths into tangible experiences for international audiences. Then, we dive into the $11 billion short-drama industry in Hengdian to meet foreign actors who have crossed oceans to find their spotlight in China’s booming cinema. From digital wonders to the bustling sets of Hengdian, see how China is reshaping imagination for a new era.

programme.title: From Island Farms to Cloud Power, From Mountain Hubs to Urban Beats
programme.desc: From tropical coffee aromas to high-tech computing hubs, how is China defining "high-quality development"? In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the fields of Wanning, Hainan, where a small coffee bean becomes a symbol of the Free Trade Port’s opening-up, to the mountains of Guizhou, where a 14-millisecond data latency is powering the rendering of global blockbusters like Ne Zha 2. Finally, we dive into the vibrant Livehouse scene of China’s megacities, exploring a $1.2 billion "emotional economy" that is reshaping urban nightlife. From solid digital infrastructure to the rhythmic energy of the music scene, this episode captures the heartbeat of China’s evolving economic future.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: APEC China 2026 – Unlocking New opportunities for the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Leaders and representatives from 21 member economies of APEC gather in Shenzhen, China for the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. CGTN Biztalk host Michael Wang talks to senior researchers, analysts and business insiders to discuss how APEC can advance free trade and forge new consensus on artificial intelligence and supply chain resilience, decode how APEC China Year can chart a course for stronger, more cohesive regional cooperation that will shape the economic landscape for the years to come.

programme.title: Mexican entrepreneur builds a China-Latin America trade bridge in the Greater Bay Area
programme.desc: Fernanda, an entrepreneur from Mexico, has launched a trade services platform in the Greater Bay Area to help Latin American companies enter the Chinese market. For her, APEC is not just a concept on paper-it is part of her everyday work, from business negotiations to cross-border partnerships. Her team also helps Chinese companies explore Latin American markets, creating new opportunities for shared growth across the Asia-Pacific.

programme.title: APEC Selfies: An Australian entrepreneur is taking AI beyond the screen. What's next?
programme.desc: From interactive smart bins to public installations that respond to emotions, Australian product designer and Sencity co-founder Steven Bai is exploring how AI can be integrated into streets, buildings and public spaces - taking technology beyond screens and into everyday life. From conceiving his startup idea to putting down roots in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, he is drawing on China's well-developed manufacturing ecosystem to bring Physical AI innovations to global markets. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: China through the eyes of CanCham Chair
programme.desc: For Dr. Mark Ceolin, Shanghai is more than a gateway to China and the Asia-Pacific - it is where his personal journey and China-Canada connections took root. Having witnessed the city’s remarkable rise since the 2000s, he has dedicated himself to helping Canadian companies grow in China. Seeing is believing. Today, Mark guides a growing number of Canadian businesses to experience a welcoming market full of emerging possibilities.

programme.title: APEC Selfies | Brewing bridges: A Filipino entrepreneur's cross-border dream
programme.desc: What happens when a Filipino coffee lover turns his passion into a business in China? Meet Diel, founder of Nearby Coffee in Quanzhou, Fujian Province, who is serving up more than just a good brew! He's building cultural connections between China and the Philippines, with plans to take his business across borders. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: RAZOR: Shocking the System: Why China is Winning the EV Race
programme.desc: China now produces two out of every three electric vehicles sold worldwide. How did this transformation of the global auto industry happen so fast, and what does it mean for once-dominant European carmakers? Is it an unfair advantage or simply smart strategising? Jen Copestake presents Shocking the System: Why China is winning the EV race—a documentary that takes you inside China's EV revolution. We explore the supply chain dominance that's slashed production costs, and the 'Corner Overtaking' strategy that has helped Chinese automakers leapfrog their global competitors.

programme.title: RAZOR: Rise of the Humanoids
programme.desc: China's humanoid robot revolution is no longer science fiction. It is unfolding right now. From Shenzhen's first robot 6S store to advanced research labs in Shanghai, we meet the pioneers building machines that can walk, talk, fold laundry, stock supermarket shelves, and even box. Featuring insights from Dr Liu Shaoshan, Unitree Robotics, and AgiBot, this episode explores embodied AI, robotic hands with human-like touch, and the race to bring humanoids into factories and eventually into our homes. The question is no longer if they will enter our world, but when.

programme.title: BizPodcast: Why are global entrepreneurs choosing Shenzhen?
programme.desc: What makes Shenzhen such an attractive place to launch a business? With the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting approaching, all eyes are on this innovation-driven city in China. But beyond its reputation as a tech hub, what does it actually take to turn a big idea into a real product here? In this episode of #BizPodcast, CGTN talks with two entrepreneurs about why they chose Shenzhen, how they bring ideas to market, and what young founders should know before starting a business. Would you consider starting a business in Shenzhen? What would you want to know first?

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Climate change is changing French wine
programme.desc: CGTN's new special program "Vive La Tech" focuses on some of the coolest science collaborations between China and France. In this episode, we shift our attention to climate change and the grape at risk. Follow our reporter Yang Zhao into the vineyards.

programme.title: Vive La Tech: Approaching the limits of temperature measurement
programme.desc: In this episode of CGTN's special program "Vive La Tech," we dive into the "frozen world". In low-temperature metrology, scientists created the world's most precise temperature measuring device, from 5 to 24.5 kelvin, providing a source for all thermometers around the world. Join CGTN reporter Yang Zhao to explore how such an innovative partnership can open new doors for fundamental science.

programme.title: Guangdong Expands Opening Up to Connect with Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Guangdong Province has long been one of China's pioneers in opening up. As the country's leading provincial trader, Guangdong is deepening economic ties with the Asia-Pacific through trade, innovation and closer cooperation. From coffee machines made in Shunde to robots developed through Guangdong-Hong Kong collaboration, companies are finding new opportunities across the region. The province has been China's largest provincial trader for 40 years, with last year's imports and exports topping 9 trillion yuan (about 1.3 trillion US dollars) and more than 20 million market entities. Shunde is now the world's largest coffee machine production base, with Gemilai alone shipping to over 60 countries and selling more than two million units. Leveraging the Greater Bay Area's innovation hub, Guangdong is also advancing Guangdong-Hong Kong robotics projects and, as Shenzhen hosts APEC this year, aims to deepen regional industrial and supply-chain links for shared growth.

programme.title: Shared Future for Asia Pacific: Best-selling hair dryer highlights strengths of southern China's cross-border supply chain
programme.desc: As China hosts APEC 2026, regional integration is taking center stage. In southern China's Greater Bay Area, cities like Zhuhai, Hengqin, and Macao are operating like a single supply chain network, linking automated factories with global talent and capital. To see how this cross-border teamwork helps brands go global, CGTN's Yu Hongyu takes us inside a hair dryer factory in Zhuhai.

programme.title: Behind every screen: Shenzhen lights up the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: From the phone in your pocket to the giant screens lighting up city skylines, a huge share of the world's displays trace back to one place: China's Greater Bay Area, specifically Shenzhen. Panels and LED modules... the whole chain sits within a few hours' drive, and that's what lets companies scale fast. Our reporter Wang Tianyu went inside the industry to find out how Shenzhen is putting that edge to work for customers worldwide.

programme.title: From bikes to your phone: Carbon fiber weaves the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: Carbon fiber-once reserved for aerospace and elite racing-is now powering a much broader industrial shift across the Asia-Pacific. In southern China, Guangdong province is turning lower-cost mass production into a major export advantage. CGTN's Yu Hongyu explores how this featherlight thread is is driving billions in APEC trade.

programme.title: OFFSHORE WIND Powers the Asia-Pacific
programme.desc: You flip a switch, and the lights come on. But where does that power come from? In Yangjiang, Guangdong, the answer lies offshore. The city leads all of China's prefecture-level cities in offshore wind capacity, backed by a growing industrial chain spanning turbine manufacturing, testing and operations. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun takes you inside China's offshore wind industry and explores how it is helping power the Asia-Pacific's green transition.

programme.title: From receptionist to manager: Elizabeth's 8-year journey at a Chinese firm
programme.desc: Elizabeth Lindon, a 46-year-old from Papua New Guinea, is now a senior supervisor at BNBM PNG in Port Moresby. Over eight years, she has worked her way up from office receptionist to forklift operator--breaking the stereotype that operating forklifts is "a man's job"--and then moving into management. Her journey shows how China-APEC cooperation translates into real benefits for individuals and families. CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: How a Chinese company helped Danang's tofu business thrive in Indonesia
programme.desc: Pak Danang makes tofu in Mendis Village, Indonesia. He once had no license and no steady buyers -- until China Datang Power Plant stepped in with hygiene training, permits, soybeans and a supply deal with a company cafeteria. His monthly income has since jumped from IDR 12 million to 42 million ($2,300). A livelihood transformed, one block of tofu at a time. This is China-APEC cooperation made real! CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: From 36 hours to 40 minutes: Peruvian captain's
programme.desc: Freyder Caldas Cierto ferries villagers along Peru's Huallaga River for EGH, operator of the Chaglla Hydropower Plant. Since 2015, the free community boat service has served five villages -- turning a day-and-a-half-long mule ride into a 40-minute trip. A Chinese-operated project connecting riverside lives, one trip at a time! CGTN presents a special series on the role of China's centrally administered SOEs in the Asia-Pacific, in collaboration with China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC). The series explores their contributions to regional connectivity, green transition, the digital economy, industrial cooperation and people's livelihoods, with insights on building a shared future for the region. #APECChina2026 #APECChinaYear

programme.title: Travel the world without a passport - inside CIIE's Country Exhibition
programme.desc: This year's Country Exhibition is the expo's "international living room," welcoming Canada back as Guest Country of Honor and Sri Lanka for its debut. It also features first-time participants Moldova, Romania, and UNDP, bringing together advanced and emerging economies. It's a showcase of unique products, cultures, and business opportunities. What new surprises await? Follow CGTN's Wu Bin and Chen Tong for a global tour under one roof.

programme.title: Live: What's next after CIIE 2026?
programme.desc: What stood out at this year's China International Import Expo (CIIE)? And what does it mean for businesses? They'll also discuss what these changes mean for global companies and the opportunities China's market offers.

programme.title: Dialogue at the world's largest port: Building resilient port cities together
programme.desc: How can port cities stay resilient amid global trade uncertainty? A sub-forum of the Global Mayors Dialogue in Ningbo was held at the Ningbo Zhoushan Port — the world's No.1 port in cargo throughput for 17 straight years. CGTN's Michael Wang spoke with Ningbo's Vice Mayor and guests from Cotonou (Benin), Klang Royal City (Malaysia) and Toamasina (Madagascar). Arctic shipping routes, green corridors, sister-port cooperation — the insights keep coming!

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Cheers: Rache ist süß
programme.desc: Sam möchte sich an dem arroganten Yuppie-Gastronom John Allen Hill rächen. Deshalb schickt er die für ihre Niedertracht bekannte Carla zu seinem Erzfeind. Anstatt Hill fertigzumachen, geht Carla mit dem Mann ins Bett.

programme.title: Cheers: Hochzeit mit Hindernissen
programme.desc: Woody glaubt sich von Fortuna verwöhnt. Sein Nebenbuhler, der Franzose Henri, erhält ein Ausweisungsschreiben von der Einwanderungsbehörde. Allerdings hat Kelly soviel Mitleid mit Henri, dass sie sich auf eine Scheinehe einlässt.

programme.title: Cheers: Sams Ladehemmung
programme.desc: Rebecca ist trotz stetigen Beischlafs mit Sam noch immer nicht schwanger. Also vermutet sie, dass er unfruchtbar ist. Für den selbstbewussten Frauenheld Sam bricht eine Welt zusammen.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Babymacher
programme.desc: Sam und Rebecca mieten sich für ein Wochenende in einem Luxushotel ein. In romantischer Umgebung wollen sie endlich ihr langersehntes Baby zeugen.

programme.title: Cheers: Elvis lebt
programme.desc: Carla glaubt fest daran, dass Elvis noch lebt. Heute, an seinem Geburtstag, wird er ihr ein Zeichen geben. Sam hat derweil Frisurprobleme. Weil sein Friseur im Krankenhaus liegt, lässt er sich die Haare von Woody schneiden. Das Ergebnis ist grauenhaft.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Zombie-Oma
programme.desc: Woody schenkt Kelly zur Verlobung einen sündhaft teuren Ring. Das stürzt ihn in Probleme: Das Präsent ist so teuer, dass er sich von seinem Kellnergehalt nicht einmal die Raten für das Schmuckstück leisten kann.

programme.title: Cheers: Mein Sohn, der Priester
programme.desc: Carla ist begeistert, als sie erfährt, dass ihr Sohn Gino Priester werden will. Sie glaubt nämlich, dass sie mit einem Geistlichen in der Familie problemlos in den Himmel kommt.

programme.title: Cheers: Frasiers Ex-Frau
programme.desc: Frasier besucht mit Lilith und seinem Sohn Frederick das Konzert des Kinderidols Nanny Gee. In der Künstlerin erkennt er seine Ex-Frau wieder, von der Lilith nichts weiß. Auch Nanny Gee erkennt Frasier. Sie setzt nun alles daran, ihn zurückzuerobern.

programme.title: Cheers: Unerfüllte Liebe
programme.desc: Woodys Cousin Russell wird als Pianist in Cheers eingestellt. Er verliebt sich unsterblich in Rebecca. Als diese ihn in sein Motelzimmer begleitet, entdeckt sie dort ein überlebensgroßes Bild von sich. Das geht Rebecca zu weit.

programme.title: Cheers: Pokerface Woody
programme.desc: John Hill erwartet Besuch von den Witwen der Weltkriegsveteranen. Er bittet die Cheers-Truppe um einen Gefallen: Die Jungs sollen sich verbal zurückhalten, da man durch den Lüftungsschacht jedes Wort hören kann.

programme.title: Cheers: Armer reicher Woody
programme.desc: Woody kehrt mit seiner Freundin Kelly von einer Europareise zurück. Dank ihres Geldes ist er nun übermäßig gut gekleidet und in die feinen Umgangsformen eingeweiht. Leider stößt er mit seinem Benehmen auf Befremden.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Zweithochzeit
programme.desc: Liliths Mutter kommt zu Besuch. Die resolute Dame nörgelt an allem herum. Sie verlangt sogar, dass Lilith und Frasier ihre Hochzeit wiederholen. Derweil freut sich Sam auf eine Reise nach Atlantik City.

programme.title: Cheers: Hosen runter!
programme.desc: Lilith muss für ein paar Tage weg. Schweren Herzens überlässt sie Frasier die Verantwortung für das Haus. Seine erste verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe: Er soll die Laborratte Schnurri abholen und ordnungsgemäß versorgen.

programme.title: Cheers: Rebeccas Liebhaber
programme.desc: Rebecca fiebert einem Wiedersehen mit ihrer ersten großen Liebe Mark entgegen. Als er ankommt, ist sie so begeistert, dass ihr ein wichtiges Detail entgeht: Mark hat sich inzwischen zu seiner Homosexualität bekannt.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg Der Kneipen – Teil 6
programme.desc: Gary hat seine ,,Old Town Tavern" verkauft. Die Cheers-Truppe hofft nun, den traditionellen Kneipenkrieg mit seinem Nachfolger fortzusetzen. Doch weit gefehlt: Der neue Besitzer scheint keinen Spaß zu verstehen. Er ist überdies ein berüchtigter Mafiaboss.

programme.title: Cheers: Oh, wie witzig!
programme.desc: Cliff versucht seit Jahren erfolglos, einen Witz in der Show von Johnny Carson unterzubringen. Erneut trifft eine Absage ein. Um Cliff aufzuheitern, verändert Norm den Inhalt des Briefes mit Tipp-Ex. Nun will Cliff sofort nach Hollywood fliegen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der große Tag – Teil 1
programme.desc: Der große Tag ist da: Die Hochzeit von Woody und Kelly soll stattfinden. Carla erstellt den Brautleuten ein Horoskop. Laut ihrer Prognose wird der Tag jedoch ein Desaster. Unterdessen legt sich Rebecca mit dem Chefkoch an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der große Tag – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sam versucht, Woodys großen Tag trotz aller Unglücksfälle noch zu retten. Schnell ist ein Ersatz für den verstorbenen Priester gefunden: Cliffs Onkel Roger. Der muss aber zunächst ausgenüchtert werden.

programme.title: Cheers: Zeugung mit Hindernissen
programme.desc: Sams und Rebeccas Entschluss steht fest: Sie wollen ein Baby zeugen. Die beiden treffen sich zu einem romantischen Schäferstündchen in Rebeccas Apartment. Leider versagt ausgerechnet jetzt Sams so oft gepriesene Potenz.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Club der harten Männer
programme.desc: Sam, Cliff, Frasier und Norm brechen mit dem Auto in die Wildnis auf. Dort wollen sie ihre männlichen Seelen neu entdecken. Die wahren Männer entpuppen sich als wahre Schwächlinge.

programme.title: Cheers: Madame Carla
programme.desc: Carla ist verunsichert: Sie wird von Madame Lazora, ihrer spirituellen Beraterin, zur Nachfolgerin erkoren. Angeblich verfügt über Carla ebenfalls mediale Fähigkeiten. Schon bald ist sie beseelt vom Geist einer gewissen ,,Prinzessin Katja"

programme.title: Cheers: Schmücke dein Heim
programme.desc: Norm streicht das Wohnzimmer von Lilith und Frasier. Durch ein Missgeschick des Hausherrn verrenkt der ,,Handwerker" sich einen Wirbel. Die Cranes verfrachten Norm daraufhin auf die Couch, um ihn zu verwöhnen. Prompt lädt Norm alle Freunde vom Cheers ein.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff ist voller Vorfreude: Endlich kehrt seine große Liebe, die Postbotin Margaret, nach Boston zurück. Leider kündig auch seine notorisch schlecht gelaunte Mutter Esther ihren Besuch an.

programme.title: Cheers: Kindersegen
programme.desc: Sam und Rebecca wollen beweisen, dass sie zukünftig gute Eltern werden. Deshalb stellen sie sich der härtesten Herausforderung in dieser Disziplin. Sie wollen eine Nacht auf Carlas widerspenstige Kinder aufpassen.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg der Kneipen – Teil 5
programme.desc: Es ist Halloween. Sam möchte seinem Erzfeind Gary einen gehörigen Streich spielen. Der erscheint jedoch plötzlich im Cheers und bittet um Waffenstillstand. Sein Arzt hat ihm einen zu hohen Blutdruck attestiert. Ein Schreck könnte tödliche Folgen haben.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Erbsenzähler
programme.desc: Sam, Woody, Norm und Cliff finden keine Ruhe. Sie beschäftigen sich mit der weltbewegenden Frage, mit wieviel Bolzen die Spielarena der lokalen Basketballmannschaft verschraubt ist. Deshalb brechen die vier nachts in die Halle ein und zählen nach.

programme.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
programme.desc: En esta serie el hijo de una familia rural emigrada a la ciudad narra su adolescencia en los sesenta. Es la visión tiernamente humorística de un narrador que revive sus años juveniles desde su madurez. A través de los ojos de Carlos Alcántara, se observa la transformación de una familia de baja clase media de la época. Para la familia Alcántara, y para todo el país, aquella fue una época de ruptura con el pasado, de nuevas esperanzas y nuevos temores. A través de esta familia, y con las referencias que proporciona el archivo televisivo, se ejemplifica la gran transformación española: los cambios sociales y los hitos históricos, desde el asesinato de Carrero Blanco hasta las primeras elecciones democráticas pasando por la muerte de Franco y la coronación de Juan Carlos.

programme.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
programme.desc: Antonio lleva cuatro días sin hablar a Mercedes por el asunto de la adopción. Por si fuera poco, tienen que preparar el bautizo, con todo lo que ello conlleva. Deben decidir qué nombre poner a la niña, así como cuál de las dos abuelas será la madrina. Este último asunto será fuente de problemas. El matrimonio Alcántara había pensado celebrar tras el bautizo una modesta merienda familiar, pero Don Pablo conmina a Antonio a preparar un gran banquete con invitados de postín. Y es que su nuevo cargo de Director Gerente de Construcciones Nueva York conlleva una intensa vida social. Queda apenas una semana para el estreno de la obra ''Llama un inspector'' y continúan las envidias entre los actores, esta vez por la confección del cartel que lo anuncia. Mientras, Diego Barrios pone en práctica con Inés los métodos más duros para que aproveche sus aptitudes interpretativas.

programme.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
programme.desc: Por fin se representa en la parroquia la obra ''Llama un inspector'', y todos los actores tienen los típicos nervios previos al estreno. Inés acude a Diego para tranquilizarse mientras que Mercedes, por su parte, está un poco harta de que la obra de teatro desvíe a su hija de sus obligaciones en la boutique. Por si fuera poco, Nieves y Pili andan siempre a la greña delante de las clientas por sus diferencias en torno a la obra. Después de los gastos del bautizo de Teresa, Antonio está muy preocupado porque no consigue que don Pablo le asigne un sueldo fijo. Éste prefiere que su subordinado gane dinero a través de las sospechosas comisiones de los proveedores de la constructora. Antonio, más honesto que su jefe, se verá ante un gran dilema moral.

programme.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
programme.desc: Los Alcántara están preocupados por la falta de noticias de Teresa y su madre, Socorro. Antonio y Mercedes tratarán de dar con la familia a la que sirve Socorro para tener noticias de la niña. Por si fuera poco para el matrimonio Alcántara, Inés se entusiasma cada vez más con el mundo del teatro y con su mentor, Diego Barrios, mientras Mercedes se preocupa porque su hija desatiende sus obligaciones en la boutique y sólo piensa en ver representaciones. Por otro lado, Antonio, que cada vez se encuentra más orgulloso de su cargo de Director Gerente, se ve obligado de nuevo a hacer un favor a don Pablo. Éste, ante una inminente inspección, pide a su subordinado que se lleve a su casa unos libros de contabilidad de la imprenta. Además, en la mili, un cabo obliga a Toni a acudir en su lugar a una cita con su novia (interpretada por María Isasi). El encuentro se desarrollará de forma inesperada.

programme.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
programme.desc: Inés, que está entusiasmada con el mundo del teatro, cree que ha encontrado su auténtica vocación. Diego le consigue la oportunidad de presentarse a una prueba de una gran compañía teatral para sustituir a una actriz en un pequeño papel. A Antonio y Mercedes les aterra la idea de que su hija se meta en el mundo del teatro. Su incomprensión, sobre todo la de Antonio, choca de pleno con la determinación de Inés. Por fin se produce la inspección fiscal de la imprenta. Don Pablo da el día libre a Antonio para que no meta la pata. Parece que esta vez sólo un milagro puede salvar a don Pablo de que sus trapicheos sean descubiertos. Mientras, en casa, las abuelas siguen a la greña. El origen de los problemas será en este caso el premio de un concurso radiofónico. Al final, Pura y Herminia se llevarán una sorpresa.

programme.title: Cuéntame cómo pasó
programme.desc: Inés decide dejar su trabajo en Meyni para dedicarse plenamente al teatro, lo que agota la paciencia de sus padres. Antonio tiene con ella una fortísima discusión que acarreará graves consecuencias. Mercedes se pasa el día trabajando para terminar un encargo de muchos vestidos. Por si fuera poco, en la tienda no recibe mucha ayuda puesto que Pili y Nieves no piensan en otra cosa más que en adelgazar, algo incomprensible para la generación de Herminia y Pura, que había sufrido el hambre de la posguerra. Fuera del hogar, a Antonio parece irle muy bien. Don Pablo por fin le da un adelanto, y además le invita a una cena en su casa para celebrar la puesta en marcha de Construcciones Nueva York. Al banquete asistirá una pareja de excepción: Los Altamira. Toni ya está acabando su período de instrucción, en el que ha hecho buenos amigos. Para guasa de Álvaro, Mario le pide que le enseñe a bailar. Y es que su poca maña en estas lides no le ayuda mucho a ligar cuando sale de permiso.

Para la familia Alcántara, y para todo el país, aquella fue una época de ruptura con el pasado, de nuevas esperanzas y nuevos temores. A través de esta familia, y con las referencias que proporciona el archivo televisivo, se ejemplifica la gran transformación española: los cambios sociales y los hitos históricos, desde el asesinato de Carrero Blanco hasta las primeras elecciones democráticas pasando por la muerte de Franco y la coronación de Juan Carlos.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny ist in Cartman drin!
programme.desc: Cartman hat immer noch Kenny's nervenden Geist in seinem Körper. Den will er mit Hilfe eines Fernsehmediums vertreiben, merkt aber schnell, dass das Medium ein Flop ist.

programme.title: South Park: Mein Zukunfts-Ich und Ich
programme.desc: Stan wird zu Hause von einem üblen Besucher überrascht. Der Mann behauptet, Stan zu sein und aus der Zukunft zu kommen. Allerdings ist er nicht das geworden, was sich Stan's Eltern gewünscht haben.

programme.title: South Park: Guter Krüppel, schlechter Krüppel
programme.desc: Jimmy und Timmy machen sich auf die Suche nach Gleichgesinnten und treffen auf die Crips. Sie ahnen nicht, dass es sich hierbei nicht um Behinderte handelt, die nach Annerkennung suchen, sondern um eine brutale Gang.

programme.title: South Park: Unglaublich geldgeile Ureinwohner
programme.desc: Die Besitzer des großen indianischen Casinos Three Feathers haben South Park aufgekauft. Sie wollen einen neuen Super Highway bauen und die Bürger dazu zwingen ihr Land zu verlassen. Das können die Kids nicht zulassen.

programme.title: South Park: Revolution der alten Säcke
programme.desc: Die Senioren müssen ihre Führerscheine abgeben, nachdem sie auf der Straße ein Chaos angerichtet haben. Stans Großvater bitte die AARP um Hilfe.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle's Eltern gehen mit ihm und seinen Freunden Stan, Kenny und Butters zu seinem Geburtstag ins Casa Bonita. Als Cartman herausfindet, dass er nicht eingeladen ist, sorgt er dafür, dass Butters verschwindet.

programme.title: South Park: Mormonen machen sich was vor
programme.desc: Eine Mormonenfamilie zieht mit ihrem Sohn Gary nach South Park. Eric freundet sich mit Gary an, ist von der ganzen Mormonen-Sache jedoch enttäuscht.

programme.title: South Park: Kippe weg!
programme.desc: Die Kids werden beim Rauchen erwischt und die Schule geht in Flammen auf. Eine radikale Anti-Raucher-Gruppe taucht auf und will Cartmann umbringen, um die Gefahr des Passivrauchens aufzuzeigen.

programme.title: South Park: Wir sind Grufties
programme.desc: Nachdem Wendy mit Stan Schluss gemacht hat, wird dieser zum Grufti und versinkt in seinem Schmerz.

programme.title: South Park: Mit der Spritze an die Spitze
programme.sub-title: Mit der Spritze an die Spitze
programme.desc: Jimmy stählt sich wacker für den Behinderten-Sportcontest. Als er realisiert, dass die Konkurrenz einfach zu stark ist, kommt der Typ mit den Stereoiden gerade richtig.

programme.title: South Park: Kampf um Quoten
programme.desc: Die Jungs kreieren für die Schule eine Nachrichtensendungg die es jedoch nicht mit der Konkurrenz von Craigs Show aufnehmen kann.

programme.title: South Park: Siegertypen
programme.desc: Von wegen Freizeit: Weil die South Park-Jungs einfach zu gut dabei sind, schaffen sie es mit ihrem Baseball-Team sogar in die Playoffs. Um nicht die ganzen Ferien auf dem Baseball-Feld zu verbringen, muss eine Niederlage her - und zwar schnell.

programme.title: South Park: Im Körper des Feindes
programme.desc: Auftakt zur South Park Jubiläums Reihe anlässlich des 15 jährigen Geburtstags der Serie. Dieses Mal moderiert Cartman die Show unter dem Motto 'Cartman in Control'.

programme.title: South Park: Schrankgeflüster
programme.desc: Um endlich ein neues Fahrrad kaufen zu können, will Stan auf teure Freizeitaktivitäten verzichten. Auf der Suche nach kostenlosen Möglichkeiten stößt Stan auf einen Persönlichkeitstest von Scientology der ergibt, dass er depressiv und unglücklich ist.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Die Jungs machen derbe Erfahrungen mit den Fahr- und Alkoholkünsten von Stans Vater, als dieser sie vom Karate abholt und ihnen zeigen will, wie man während des Autofahrens trinken und in eine Flasche pinkeln kann!

programme.title: South Park: Snobwarnung
programme.desc: Stan setzt sich voll für die Etablierung von Hybrid-Autos in South Park ein und hat richtig Erfolg!

programme.title: South Park: Viel Frottee um nichts
programme.desc: Towelie, ein den Drogen sehr geneigter Kellner in South Park, verliert wegen seines anhaltend-starken Konsums seinen Job und beschließt, sein Leben niederzuschreiben.

programme.title: South Park: Mannbärschwein
programme.desc: Die Jungs begehen einen großen Fehler, als sie Al Gore in eine Höhle folgen, um ein angeblich mutiertes Mischwesen aufzuspüren. Durch einen Erdrutsch wird die Höhle verschüttet - jetzt heißts, ums Überleben kämpfen!

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Cartmans Mutter kommt zu dem Schluss, dass sie ihren Sohn nicht länger unter Kontrolle hat. Cesar 'Der Hundeflüsterer' Millan soll ihr dabei helfen, wieder einen Zugang zu Cartman zu finden. Dieser aber beschließt, sich mit allen Mitteln zu wehren!

programme.title: South Park: Scheiß Paranoia
programme.desc: Jemand hat das Schulklo verstopft und Mr. Mackey versucht durch intensive Befragung der 4. Klasse die Schuldigen zu finden. Cartman vermutet, dass hinter der Sache eine ähnliche Verschwörung wie hinter den Geschehnissen am 11 September stecken könnte.

programme.title: South Park: Gott ist tot
programme.desc: Inspiriert vom Unterricht in der Schule versucht Cartman alles, um in die Zukunft zu gelangen ohne etwas von der Gegenwart mitzukriegen. Was böte sich da eher an, als sich einzufrieren?

programme.title: South Park: Gott ist tot II
programme.desc: Nachdem sich Cartman eingefroren hat um die Zeit zum Wii-Launchtermin nicht mitkriegen zu müssen, erwacht er 500 Jahre zu spät aus seinem eisigen Schlaf. Die Zukunft gefällt ihm überhaupt nicht.

programme.title: South Park: Stanley's Cup
programme.desc: Stan wird dazu verdonnert, das Icehockey-Team 'Peewee' zu trainieren. Ob Stan es wohl schaffen wird, aus der Truppe, in der er selbst als vierjähriger eher minder erfolgreich mitspielte, ein schlagkräftiges Team zu formen?

programme.title: South Park: Bitte ein 'N'
programme.desc: Bei einer Live-Übertragung im Fernsehen begeht Stans Vater den folgenschweren Fehler, das Wort 'Nigger' zu sagen - und das, obwohl er kein Rassist ist.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman Sucks
programme.desc: Cartman hat ein neues Hobby entdeckt: In regelmäßigen Abständen verabredet er sich mit Butters zum Übernachten. Während Butters schläft, macht Cartman dann peinliche Fotos von ihm.

programme.title: South Park: Barsch-zu-Mund
programme.desc: Die Schule wird von der neuen Schlagzeilen-Internetseite 'Eavesdropper' in Atem gehalten. Keine noch so kleine Sensation oder Peinlichkeit entgeht den Machern dieser Seite und so kommt jede Peinlichkeit sofort ans Tageslicht.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: Die US-Regierung verkündet die Ergebnisse der South Park Grundschule an einem Fitnesstest. 99% der Schüler haben dabei ein akzeptables Ergebnis erzielt, während ein einziges Kind schlecht abgeschnitten hat.

programme.title: South Park: Immer Ärger mit Proll-Trash
programme.desc: Die Eltern von Kenny landen in einem Gefängnis, weil sie ein illegales Drogenlabor in ihrem Haus betreiben. Kenny selbst wird daraufhin gemeinsam mit seinen Geschwistern Kevin McCormick und Karen McCormick in die Obhut eines Pflegeheims gegeben...

programme.title: South Park: Faith Hilling
programme.desc: Cartman geht mit dem letzten Schrei in Sachen „Internet-Meme“ zu weit und unterbricht mit „Faith-Hilling“ eine politische Veranstaltung. Stan findet den Trend total doof.

programme.desc: Die Jungs freuen sich auf einen gefährlichen Tag in den Bergen von Colorado, wo sie zum Ziplining angemeldet sind. Doch es wird weniger spannend als erwartet.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Por lo general, es fácil determinar cómo un criminal entró en la escena del crimen. Pero en este caso, estaba lejos de esclarecerse. Parecía que el asesino se desvaneció y quizá lo hizo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una bomba, construida para poder causar tanto daño como sea posible, mata a la víctima con una fuerza y llama mortal.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando Ryan Stallings, de cuatro meses, muere en circunstancias sospechosas, su madre finalmente es condenada por su asesinato. Pero meses después, surgen nuevas pruebas de una fuente sorprendente – su hermano recién nacido.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2005, David Castor sufrió una muerte lenta y agonizante durante varios días. Su esposa Stacey sostuvo que fue un suicidio, a pesar de que se hizo con un anticongelante.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La policía de California tenía varios sospechosos en el robo y brutal asesinato de una pareja de ancianos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentra a Joann Katrinak muerta en un campo de maíz con su hijo pequeño, el sospechoso más obvio es el esposo y padre de las víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: El Negocio de Metales
programme.desc: Los médicos no pueden identificar el origen de la enfermedad de un empresario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un guardia de seguridad desapareció de su puesto sin dejar rastro. Sus restos fueron encontrados un año después en un campamento lejano.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un barco camaronero de dos hombres se hundió cuando una violenta tormenta de rápido movimiento azotó la costa de Luisiana. El capitán se ahogó y el marinero fue rescatado catorce horas después.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Poco después del amanecer, se inicia un incendio en un contenedor de basura en Vancouver. Nadie ve al pirómano ni el fuego, que arde durante horas en el estacionamiento desolado. Pero hay más que basura en este contenedor en llamas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer fue brutalmente asesinada en su casa y los únicos testigos del crimen fueron los perros de la familia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el verano de 1986, el cuerpo de Kathleen Lipscomb fue encontrado en una carretera desierta en las afueras de San Antonio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un estudiante de posgrado de la Universidad Estatal de Michigan desapareció y se presumió muerto. Con la ayuda de un profesor de ciencias geológicas, la policía esperaba obtener información de su asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El fotógrafo profesional Charles Rathbun afirma que la modelo Linda Sobek murió durante un encuentro sexual consensuado que salió mal, pero el cadáver de Sobek y las imágenes digitales cuentan una historia más siniestra.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Mientras estaba practicando tiros en un hermoso día de primavera, Martin Dillon es asesinado con disparos. Su amigo sostiene que fue un extraño accidente, pero se necesitan más de 20 años para que la verdad salga a la luz.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Destinado a la cárcel
programme.desc: Una mujer es encontrada muerta en un barranco, pero las fuertes tormentas habían arrastrado pruebas cruciales de la escena del crimen. En dos ocasiones, el rastro se estancó.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Un recuerdo conmovedor
programme.desc: Una niña inteligente de Visalia, California recuerda dejar huellas dactilares en el vehículo de su secuestrador cuando es secuestrada, lo que ayuda a la policía en su búsqueda junto con una huella de neumático en el barro.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Batallón de pruebas
programme.desc: Una madre de dos niños pequeños fue encontrada muerta en su habitación.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando Lori Auker, de 19 años, salió de su casa de Pennsylvania para ir a trabajar y nunca llegó, se necesitó de la tecnología de la era espacial, pelos de gato e insectos para identificar al secuestrador de la mujer.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Mark Fair se fue a trabajar y su prometida, Karla Brown, se quedó en casa. Más tarde, la encontró muerta. Durante la autopsia, se volvieron a examinar las marcas de mordeduras en su cuerpo y la odontología forense identificó al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Programado para el desastre
programme.desc: Una mujer de 29 años murió instantáneamente cuando una bomba explotó en su casa. El dispositivo era tan poderoso que la metralla estaba incrustada en las casas al otro lado de la calle.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Llamado desde Casa
programme.desc: Una investigación de asesinato en Florida atraviesa jurisdicciones de New York y Jamaica.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1999, Susan Fassett fue abatida a tiros cuando salía de su práctica de coro de la iglesia en Poughkeepsie, Nueva York. Su esposo Jeff se convirtió en el principal sospechoso, hasta que fue absuelto por la policía.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Un disparo en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Una mujer es asesinada a tiros. ¿Pero fue un homicidio o un suicidio? Se necesitaría la experiencia de expertos forenses y dos juicios con jurado para determinar el destino del asesino acusado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Parece que una mujer ha perdido el control de su camioneta SUV y ha caído en el barranco de un arroyo profundo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Dos residentes de Seattle mueren después de tomar un analgésico de venta libre. El análisis de laboratorio de las pastillas muestra que estaban contaminadas con una concentración letal de cianuro. Originalmente lanzado como Temporada 2, Episodio 9.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La víctima había ingerido una gran cantidad de cianuro. Una pista muy improbable: una falla en el sobre de correo, expuso a un asesino que estaba dispuesto a matar a gente inocente.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Pelo de perro
programme.desc: Sin evidencia forense dentro de la escena del crimen, los investigadores estaban desconcertados. Pero sospecharon que el perro de la víctima había sido testigo del crimen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, cuando un grupo fundamentalista comienza a robar bancos cerca de Spokane, las autoridades saben de inmediato que están tratando con criminales con experiencia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer desaparece y su esposo se convierte en el principal sospechoso – especialmente después de que la policía encuentra una gran mancha de sangre en la alfombra de su habitación.

programme.desc: This documentary project explores the character of different American states and cities through the stories of their people, history, culture, and food. programme.title: The Requin
द रिक्विन
தி ரெக்வின்
ది రిక్విన్
द रेक्विन
programme.desc: A grieving couple on a romantic beach vacation gets swept out to sea in their broken villa due to a tropical storm and struggles to survive as sharks target them.
एक दुखी पति-पत्नी रोमांटिक बीच पर छुट्टी मनाने जाते हैं, जहाँ भरी तूफान आता है और वे विला समेत समुद्र में बह जाते हैं। शार्क के हमले के बीच वे बचने की कोशिश करते हैं।
கடலுக்குள் அடித்துச் செல்லப்பட்ட தம்பதியினர், சுறாக்கள் தாக்குவதால் உயிர் பிழைக்கப் போராடுகின்றனர்.
తుఫాను కారణంగా శిధిలమైన తమ విల్లా సముద్రంలో కొట్టుకుపోతున్న ఒక జంటని సొరచేప వెంటాడడంతో వారు ప్రాణాల కోసం పోరాడతారు.
समुद्रकिनाऱ्यावर सुट्टीसाठी गेलेले एक जोडपे, वादळामुळे समुद्रात वाहून गेल्यावर, शार्क्सपासून वाचण्यासाठी धडपड करते.

programme.title: Nadana Arangam
नादाना अरंगम
நடன அரங்கம்
నాదన అరంగం
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the grace and beauty of Indian classical dances as gifted artists perform enchanting Bharatanatyam and Odissi numbers.
प्रतिभाशाली कलाकारों द्वारा मनमोहक भरतनाट्यम और ओडिसी नृत्यों की प्रस्तुति के साथ, भारतीय शास्त्रीय नृत्यों की सुंदरता और सौंदर्य को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
பரதநாட்டியம் மற்றும் ஒடிசி நடனங்களை கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்தும்போது, ​​இந்திய பாரம்பரிய நடனங்களின் அழகில் மூழ்கிவிடுங்கள்.
ప్రతిభావంతులైన శాస్త్రీయ కళాకారులు అద్భుతమైన భరతనాట్యం, ఒడిస్సీ నృత్యంతో ప్రేక్షకులను మంత్రముగ్దులను చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Bhakthi Maalai
भक्ति मालै
பக்தி மாலை
భక్తి మాలై
programme.desc: Various talented music artists and vocalists perform some of the most revered devotional songs in praise of the Almighty.
प्रतिभाशाली संगीत कलाकार और गायक, भगवान की स्तुति एवं आराधना में कुछ सबसे प्रतिष्ठित भक्ति गीत प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
பல்வேறு திறமையான இசைக்கலைஞர்களும் பாடகர்களும் இறைவனைப் போற்றும் சில பக்திப் பாடல்களைப் தொடர்ந்து பாடுகிறார்கள்.
వివిధ ప్రతిభావంతులైన సంగీత కళాకారులు మరియు గాయకులు, భగవంతుని స్తుతిస్తూ అత్యంత ఆదరణ పొందిన భక్తి గీతాలను ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: Nadha Sangamam
नाधा संगमम
நாத சங்கமம்
నాద సంగమం
programme.desc: Renowned singers and musicians perform a collection of melodious classical songs written by prolific artists and songwriters.
विख्यात गायक और संगीतकार प्रतिभाशाली कलाकारों और गीतकारों द्वारा रचित मधुर शास्त्रीय गीतों का एक संग्रह प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
புகழ்பெற்ற பாடகர்கள், இசைக்கலைஞர்கள்-பாடலாசிரியர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட மெல்லிசை கிளாசிக்கல் பாடல்களை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
ప్రముఖ గాయకులు, సంగీతకారులు ప్రఖ్యాత కళాకారులు, సంగీత రచయితలు అందించిన మధురమైన శాస్త్రీయ గీతాల సేకరణను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Naadhaswaram
नाधस्वरम
நாதஸ்வரம்
నాదస్వరం
programme.desc: Prominent musicians and instrumentalists present some of their best musical performances using the Naadhaswaram, a traditional wind instrument.
प्रसिद्ध संगीतकार और वादक, पारंपरिक वाद्य यंत्र नादस्वरम का उपयोग करके अपनी कुछ बेहतरीन संगीत प्रस्तुतियां प्रदर्शित करते हैं।
புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களும் வாத்தியக் கலைஞர்களும், பாரம்பரியக் காற்று வாத்தியமான நாதஸ்வரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தித் தங்களின் மிகச் சிறந்த இசை நிகழ்ச்சிகளை வழங்குகிறார்கள்.
ప్రముఖ సంగీతకారులు, వాయిద్యకారులు సాంప్రదాయ వాయు వాయిద్యమైన నాదస్వరం ఉపయోగించి వారి అత్యుత్తమ ప్రదర్శనలు అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Aalayadarisanam
आलयदरीसनम
ஆலயதர்சனம்
ఆలయదర్శనం
programme.desc: The host shares information about the history and religious significance of various temples in the country to a gathering of devotees.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, भक्तों के एक समूह को देश के अलग-अलग जगहों पर स्थित मंदिरों का इतिहास और धार्मिक महत्व बताते हैं।
நாட்டின் பல கோயில்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் மத முக்கியத்துவம் பற்றிய தகவல்களை தொகுப்பாளர் பக்தர்களுக்கு பகிர்ந்து கொள்கிறார்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత దేశంలోని వివిధ దేవాలయాల చరిత్ర మరియు మతపరమైన ప్రాముఖ్యత గురించి భక్తుల సమూహానికి సమాచారాన్ని పంచుకుంటారు.

एक धर्मगुरु, भगवान की शिक्षाओं पर भक्तों को प्रवचन देते हैं और आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए उन्हें प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
ஒரு ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர், ஒரு சொற்பொழிவை நிகழ்த்தி, பின்பற்றுபவர்களை ஆன்மீகப் பாதையை எடுக்க ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు భగవంతుని బోధనల ఆధారంగా ఉపన్యాసం అందించి, అనుచరులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గాన్ని స్వీకరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

தொகுப்பாளர் நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள், மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார நிகழ்வுகள் தொடர்பான புதுப்பிப்புகளை சமஸ்கிருதத்தில் வழங்குகிறார்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత వివిధ ముఖ్యమైన వ్యవహారాలకు చెందిన తాజా వార్తా విశేషాలు, మతపరమైన, సాంస్కృతిక విశేషాలను సంస్కృతంలో అందిస్తారు.
प्रस्तुतकर्ते संस्कृत भाषेत चालू घडामोडी, धार्मिक व सांस्कृतिक घडामोडींवरील विविध ठळक घडामोडी सादर करतात.

programme.title: Aran Naamam Aayiram
अरं नामम आयिरम्

అరణ్ నామమ్ ఆయిరం
programme.desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on stories from sacred scriptures and urges the devotees to follow the path of righteousness.
एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र ग्रंथों की कहानियों पर प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों से धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने का आग्रह करते हैं।
புனித நூல்களிலிருந்து பல கதைகளை விவரித்து, நீதியின் பாதையைப் பின்பற்ற பக்தர்களை வலியுறுத்தும் ஒரு மத தலைவர்.
ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు పవిత్ర గ్రంథం నుండి అనేక కథలను వివరిస్తారు, ధర్మమార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని భక్తులను కోరతారు.

programme.desc: Individuals recite the 'Tirukkural', a collection of couplets authored by Thiruvalluvar, a renowned Tamil poet and philosopher.
लोग प्रसिद्ध तमिल कवि और दार्शनिक तिरुवल्लुवर की रचना दोहों के संग्रह 'तिरुक्कुरल' का विस्तार से पाठ करते हैं।
திருக்குறள் என்பது புகழ்பெற்ற தமிழ் கவிஞரும் துறவியுமான திருவள்ளுவர் எழுதிய 'குறள்' அல்லது பழமொழிகளின் உன்னதமானதாகும்.
ప్రసిద్ధ తమిళ కవి తిరువల్లువర్ రచించిన తమిళ ద్విపదలు, అపోరిజమ్‌ల క్లాసిక్ తిరుక్కురల్ పఠనాలు, గ్రహణశక్తిపై అందిస్తారు.

நோய்களுக்கான ஆயுர்வேத சிகிச்சைகள் குறித்து விளக்கி,ஒருவரின் ஆரோக்கியத்தை பேண குறிப்புகளை வழங்கும் மருத்துவரை அழைக்கிறது.

programme.desc: The host explores and discusses various elements of Siddha medicine while also offering brilliant expert insights on different health issues.

சித்த மருத்துவத்தின் பல கூறுகளை ஆராய்ந்து விவாதிக்கும் போது, பல்வேறு உடல்நலப் பிரச்சினைகளில் நுண்ணறிவுகளை வழங்குகிறது.
వ్యాఖ్యాత, నిపుణులతో వివిధ రకాల ఆరోగ్య సమస్యల గురించి వివరిస్తూ, సిద్ద వైద్యంలోని వివిధ అంశాల గురించి చర్చిస్తారు.

பல யோகா ஆசனங்கள், சுவாச பயிற்சிகள், ஆரோக்கியமான வாழ்க்கைக்கான தியானம் போன்றவற்றுக்கான குறிப்புகளை கொண்டுள்ள நிகழ்ச்சி.

பொது நலன் சார்ந்த பல தலைப்புகளில் சமீபத்திய செய்திகள், நிகழ்வுகள் மற்றும் முக்கிய நிகழ்வுகள் குறித்த விரிவான அறிக்கை.

programme.desc: The host invites a prominent health expert to discuss the health benefits of Ayurveda and how it helps in leading a better life in a detailed manner.

भारतीय शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप भरतनाट्यम में प्रशिक्षित एक कुशल नर्तक, शास्त्रीय संगीत पर प्रदर्शन करते हुए दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करता है।
பரதநாட்டியத்தில் பயிற்சி பெற்ற ஒரு திறமையான நடனக் கலைஞர், கிளாசிக்கல் இசைக்கு இசையமைத்து பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விக்கிறார்.
శాస్త్రీయ నృత్యమైన భారతనాట్యంలో శిక్షణ పొందిన నర్తకి, శాస్త్రీయ సంగీతానికి అద్భుతమైన నృత్యంతో ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Express News
एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़
எக்ஸ்பிரஸ் நியூஸ்
ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్ న్యూస్
एक्सप्रेस न्यूज
programme.desc: The host presents a rapid update of the top news headlines, latest happenings and significant updates from different parts of the country.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता फटाफट अंदाज में देश के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों की प्रमुख समाचार सुर्खियाँ, नवीनतम घटनाक्रम और महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நாட்டின் பல பகுதிகளில் இருந்து முக்கிய செய்தி தலைப்புகள், சமீபத்திய நிகழ்வுகள் மற்றும் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க புதுப்பிப்புகள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత దేశంలోని వివిధ ప్రాంతాల నుండి 100 అగ్ర వార్తా ముఖ్యాంశాలు, తాజా సంఘటనలు, ప్రధానాంశాలను అందిస్తారు.
प्रस्तुतकर्ते संपूर्ण जगभरातील विविध विषयांवरील बातम्या सादर करतात.

programme.title: Sarojini
सरोजिनी
சரோஜினி
సరోజిని
programme.desc: Amid complex family dynamics and social roles, a woman embarks on a journey to reclaim her identity and assert her voice within a traditional household.
जटिल पारिवारिक गत्यात्मकता और सामाजिक भूमिकाओं के बीच, एक महिला अपनी पहचान को वापस पाने और एक पारंपरिक घर के भीतर अपनी आवाज बुलंद करने की यात्रा पर निकलती है।
தனது அடையாளத்தை மீட்டெடுக்கவும், ஒரு பாரம்பரிய குடும்பத்திற்குள் தனது குரலை நிலைநாட்டவும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்கும் பெண்.
సంక్లిష్టమైన కుటుంబ గతిశీలత,సామాజిక పాత్రల మధ్య, ఒక స్త్రీ తన గుర్తింపును తిరిగి పొందడానికి ప్రయాణాన్ని ప్రారంభిస్తుంది.

programme.title: Shakthi IPS
शक्ति आईपीएस
சக்தி ஐபிஎஸ்
శక్తి ఐపీఎస్
programme.desc: A shy, small-town girl overcomes love, challenges and societal barriers in order to achieve her dream of becoming an IPS officer.
एक शर्मीली, छोटे शहर की लड़की आईपीएस अधिकारी बनने के अपने सपने को साकार करने के लिए प्यार, चुनौतियों और सामाजिक बाधाओं को पार करती है।
ஒரு கூச்ச சுபாவமுள்ள, சிறு நகரத்தை சேர்ந்த பெண், ஐபிஎஸ் அதிகாரியாக காதல், சவால்கள் மேலும் சமூக தடைகளை தாண்டி செல்கிறாள்.
ఒక చిన్న పట్టణంలో నివసించే అమ్మాయి ఐపీఎస్ కావాలనే తన కలను సాధించడానికి ప్రేమ, సవాళ్లు, సామాజిక అడ్డంకులను అధిగమించాలి.

programme.title: Seidhigal
सेयधिगल
செய்திகள்
సెయితిగల్
programme.desc: The host presents a detailed report on some of the latest news, events and important happenings on a range of topics of public interest.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता जनहित के विभिन्न विषयों से जुड़ी नवीनतम समाचारों, घटनाओं और महत्वपूर्ण घटनाक्रमों पर विस्तृत रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
பொது நலன் சார்ந்த பல தலைப்புகளில் சமீபத்திய செய்திகள், நிகழ்வுகள் மற்றும் முக்கிய நிகழ்வுகள் குறித்த விரிவான அறிக்கை.
ప్రజా ప్రయోజనకరమైన వివిధ అంశాలపై కొన్ని తాజా వార్తలు, సంఘటనలు మరియు ముఖ్యమైన సంఘటనలపై వివరణాత్మక నివేదికను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Thaayammaa Kudumbathar
थायम्मा कुडूम्बतार
தாயம்மா குடும்பத்தார்
తాయమ్మ కుటుంబంతార్
programme.desc: Thayamma takes care of her family and caters to her husband, who has a physical disability. Meanwhile, a woman who blames Thayamma and her family for her husband's death, vows revenge against them.
थायम्मा अपने परिवार सहित दिव्यांग पति की देखभाल करती है। इसी बीच, एक महिला, जो अपने पति की मौत के लिए थायम्मा और उसके परिवार को ज़िम्मेदार मानती है, उनसे बदला लेने की कसम खाती है।
ஊனமுற்ற கணவனை பார்த்துக்கொளும் தாயம்மாவிடம் ஒருத்தி அவளது கணவன் சாவிற்கு தாயம்மா தான் காரணமென பழிவாங்குவதாக கூறுகிறாள்.
తాయమ్మ వికలాంగుడైన భర్తను, కుటుంబాన్ని చూసుకోగా, ఒక మహిళ తన భర్త చావుకి కారణమైన ఆమె కుటుంబంపై పగ తీర్చుకోవాలనుకుంటుంది.

एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़
